scope: Native context configuration/lifecycle and Python compatibility evidence; not a business-value study, real-human usability panel or enterprise-readiness certification.

reproduction.prerequisites: Build the current checkout with scripts/build_binary.py; the native/source verifier must match. Start an authorized synthetic Superset fixture at 127.0.0.1:18089 with readable chart 1. The lifecycle test does not bootstrap that BI fixture.
reproduction.native_checks: RUN_CONTEXT_CARD_INTEGRATION=1 RUN_CONTEXT_HTTP_INTEGRATION=1 SIGNALWEAVE_BINARY="$PWD/dist/signalweave" SUPERSET_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18089 SUPERSET_USERNAME=admin SUPERSET_PASSWORD=admin uv run pytest -q tests/test_context_native_card_integration.py tests/test_context_native_http_integration.py
reproduction.warning: Use only a deliberately configured local test fixture, not production credentials or a production tunnel. These checks create synthetic local context/card state, not business outcomes.

observed_cli_startup.scope: One local invocation per command on the already-used binary; cache state unassessed. Diagnostic friction, not an analysis or cross-machine latency benchmark.
observed_cli_startup.conclusion: Command startup still needs improvement before claiming seamless first use.

native_opt_in_command.scope: The 10 URL cases also run in the normal suite; counts must not be added as independent business samples.

capabilities_verified: Private setup followed by context enable/disable/status commands; enablement persisted without environment injection.
Normal agent-profile guide and tools changed on reconnect, not claimed active before restart.
Source-linked context saved/reviewed/pinned; same context and card survived process restart.
Disabling/re-enabling kept saved card bindings and context revision history.
Signed HTTP context reuse, role scopes, tenant boundaries and restart with a synthetic issuer and local Superset metadata.
routing_safety_scope: A separate unit test verifies disabled tools cannot bypass an approved card required pin. The native CLI lifecycle card remains draft; it does not prove a delivered analytical outcome.

compatibility_repair.observed_failure: Python 3.11 CI lost one chart observation after a deeply nested saved-params JSON decoding failure.
compatibility_repair.fix: Tolerant parsing preserves returned observations. Query reconstruction requires readable object parameters and raises before POST; authoritative saved query context and valid large parameters retain filters and time range.
compatibility_repair.coverage: Synthetic metadata/HTTP fixtures on actual Python 3.11.6 and 3.12.10, including direct/fallback no-POST assertions; not a malformed live Superset asset trial.

review.type: Independent internal code review, not external peer review
review.initial_query_scope_blocker: A tolerant shared parser could have broadened a reconstruction request. Reviewer rejected it; explicit strict reconstruction and no-POST tests close that blocker.
review.decision: Scoped GO for the corrected code; native and software results were gathered afterward.

retained_attempts: The first full suite was explicitly stopped after the query-scope review finding. The preliminary candidate native pass is retained but not substituted for these final-source checks.
limits: Built from the feature checkout on macOS arm64; not a new published download or cross-platform native release certification.
Noninteractive scripted setup and synthetic owner review; no personal agent config changed.
No live Jev evaluation, new frontier business report or actual notification delivery in these native checks. Earlier live studies and negative comparisons remain unchanged.
Synthetic OIDC verifies protocol behavior, not a customer identity-provider deployment.
Comparative value, clean expert-led onboarding on new raw companies and scaled period-varying business workflows remain open.
